name: proof-to-video
description: Turn a theorem or lemma into a carefully expanded, narrated mathematical video.

interface.shortDescription: Expand a proof and create a synchronized mathematical video.
interface.longDescription: Build a bottom-up explanation for advanced undergraduates and beginning graduate students, then create Manim visuals, local synthetic narration, captions, chapters, and reviewed video exports.
defaultPrompt: Turn this lemma and its proof into a narrated video.
Revise the visuals while keeping the narration and timing.
